dict.string: CareCircle mirrors appointments you create here into your iPhone Calendar so reminders show up alongside your other events. Each device opts in separately.
CareCircle uses the camera to scan medication labels so you can add prescriptions without typing.
CareCircle captures your location only when you trigger SOS so your Circle can see where to send help.
CareCircle records voice handoff notes so caregivers can leave hands-free updates for the Circle.
CareCircle transcribes voice notes on this device so your hands-free updates are searchable in the feed. Transcription runs locally whenever possible.
